translateCollectibles.label: Translate quotes and chapters
translateCollectibles.description: Show quotes and Tao Te Ching chapters in your language. Turn this off to read them in English.

resumeLastGame.label: Resume game on startup
resumeLastGame.description: Reopen the last game when the app starts.

showAnimations.label: Show animations
showAnimations.description: Weather and scenery behind the cards, moving stars in the menus, and small decorative touches. Turn this off on an e-reader.

showTips.label: Show "Quick Start" tips
showTips.description: Show a quick start summary for new games.

helpFromAbove.label: Help from Above
helpFromAbove.description: Press the UFO for help when you're stuck!
helpFromAbove.offDescription: The UFO is not shown in the game header.

keepScreenAwake.label: Keep screen awake
keepScreenAwake.description: Keeps the screen on for 10 minutes after your last touch.

hapticFeedback.label: Haptic feedback
hapticFeedback.description: Vibrates on card drag and drop, and game wins. Haptics must be enabled in your phone settings.

autoComplete.label: Auto-complete board
autoComplete.description: When the rest of a game can be finished by moving cards to the foundations.

crashReports.label: Send crash reports
crashReports.description: Sends anonymous diagnostics when something goes wrong, so it can be fixed. No personal information is included.

resetData.warning: You are about to lose all your progress and preferences.

backup.label: Move your progress
backup.description: Back up your favorites, stats, Odyssey progress and collectibles, then restore them in another browser or on another device.
backup.copied: Code copied. Paste it into Solitarius on your other device.
backup.copyManually: Your browser wouldn't copy it. Select this code, copy it and keep it somewhere safe:
backup.confirmWarning: This replaces all progress and settings on this device.

errors.damaged: That backup is incomplete or damaged. Try copying it again.
errors.newer: That backup comes from a newer version of Solitarius. Reload the app to update it, then try again.

useEnglishGameTitles.label: Use English game titles
useEnglishGameTitles.description: Always show game names in English, whatever the language.

moments.label: Quiet moments
moments.description: Experience a moment of reflection after a game.
